title: Align favorites to bottom when panel is bottom-aligned
line: Kicker's sidebar sections can be swapped by dragging the separator, so favorites can sit at the bottom next to a bottom panel.
explanation: Kicker's sidebar always put favorite apps at the top and the system actions at the bottom on a non-top panel, so with a bottom panel the favorites were the furthest thing from the cursor. Christoph Wolk's open MR !3648 makes the separator draggable: dropping it on the zone that appears at the top swaps the two sections (favorites then align to the bottom, next to the panel), and dropping it in the middle or at the end changes the bottom section's alignment. The order and alignment are stored in two new applet config keys whose default keeps today's location-based layout.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: allow repositioning sidebar sections

The sidebar sections in kicker have a somewhat inflexible arrangement:
on top panels, the system actions are on top, and the applications
follow immediately (with empty space, if present, at the end) while
everywhere else, applications are on top, and system actions are bottom-
aligned (with empty space in the middle, over the separator). Users may
want them in the opposite order (e.g. to have applications closer to the
cursor position after opening them) or with different alignment; and the
current setup does not easily allow us to change the default layout
while giving existing users a way to go back to the one they're used to.
But exposing this as an option in the kicker settings feels like over-
configuration.

Instead, we make the sections repositionable through drag&drop. The
draggable area for this is the separator, which is small enough to not
interfere with regular use of kicker. Starting a drag adds an overlay
DropArea on top (for reordering the current bottom to the top) and
adds one either after the current top section or as an overlay at
the end (to change the alignment of the bottom section). The overlays
are necessary as the top/bottom may be outside the visible area, if the
sidebar has enough entries to be scrollable, and their appearance is
animated.

CCBUG: 468363

patches.diff:
From cb714efa11f7f951e855188d740da43ad1507df4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christoph Wolk <cwo.kde@posteo.net>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 12:53:05 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kicker: allow repositioning sidebar sections

The sidebar sections in kicker have a somewhat inflexible arrangement:
on top panels, the system actions are on top, and the applications
follow immediately (with empty space, if present, at the end) while
everywhere else, applications are on top, and system actions are bottom-
aligned (with empty space in the middle, over the separator). Users may
want them in the opposite order (e.g. to have applications closer to the
cursor position after opening them) or with different alignment; and the
current setup does not easily allow us to change the default layout
while giving existing users a way to go back to the one they're used to.
But exposing this as an option in the kicker settings feels like over-

Instead, we make the sections repositionable through drag&drop. The
draggable area for this is the separator, which is small enough to not
interfere with regular use of kicker. Starting a drag adds an overlay

CCBUG: 468363
---
 applets/kicker/MenuRepresentation.qml | 172 +++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 applets/kicker/main.xml               |  16 +++
 2 files changed, 183 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/MenuRepresentation.qml b/applets/kicker/MenuRepresentation.qml
index f3593a1e37..dd44790a6d 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/MenuRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/MenuRepresentation.qml
@@ -117,6 +117,7 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
 
             readonly property real innerMargin: 2
             readonly property bool onTopPanel: Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge
+            readonly property bool systemOnTop: (Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarTopCategory === 0 && sideBar.onTopPanel) || Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarTopCategory === 2
 
             visible: (root.globalFavorites.count + root.systemFavorites.count) > 0
 
@@ -151,11 +152,69 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
 
             activeFocusOnTab: true
             onActiveFocusChanged: if (activeFocus) {
-                let target = (onTopPanel && favoriteSystemActions.model.count) ? favoriteSystemActions : favoriteApps
+                const target = (systemOnTop && favoriteSystemActions.model.count) ? favoriteSystemActions : favoriteApps
                 target.forceActiveFocus(Qt.TabFocusReason)
             }
             KeyNavigation.right: rootList
 
+            component RepositionDropArea: DropArea {
+                id: repositionDropArea
+                z: 10
+                implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing * 2
+                implicitWidth: sideBar.implicitWidth - 2 * 2
+                Rectangle {
+                    anchors.fill: parent
+                    color: repositionDropArea.containsDrag ? Kirigami.Theme.positiveBackgroundColor : Kirigami.Theme.neutralBackgroundColor
+                }
+                Kirigami.Icon {
+                    anchors.centerIn: parent
+                    implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
+                    implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium
+                    source: "exchange-positions-symbolic"
+                }
+            }
+
+            RepositionDropArea {
+                id: topDropArea
+                visible: sidebarSeparator.Drag.active || topTransition.running
+                anchors {
+                    bottom: parent.top
+                    left: parent.left
+                    right: parent.right
+                    topMargin: 2
+                    leftMargin: sideBarScrollView.leftPadding + sideBar.innerMargin
+                    rightMargin: sideBarScrollView.rightPadding + sideBar.innerMargin
+                }
+                onDropped: {
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarTopCategory = sideBar.systemOnTop ? 1 : 2
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.writeConfig()
+                }
+                states: [
+                    State {
+                      name: "hidden"
+                      when: !sidebarSeparator.Drag.active
+                      AnchorChanges  {
+                          target: topDropArea
+                          anchors.bottom: parent.top
+                          anchors.top: undefined
+                        }
+                    },
+                    State {
+                        name: "visible"
+                        when: sidebarSeparator.Drag.active
+                        AnchorChanges {
+                            target: topDropArea
+                            anchors.bottom: undefined
+                            anchors.top: parent.top
+                        }
+                    }
+                ]
+                transitions: Transition {
+                    id: topTransition
+                    AnchorAnimation { duration: Kirigami.Units.shortDuration }
+                }
+            }
+
             PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
                 id: sideBarScrollView
 
@@ -186,6 +245,7 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
 
                 ColumnLayout {
                     id: sideBarLayout
+
                     anchors {
                         fill: parent
                         topMargin: sideBar.margins.top - sideBar.innerMargin
@@ -201,30 +261,91 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
                     Keys.onRightPressed: event => sideBar.handleLeftRightArrow(event)
 
                     LayoutItemProxy {
-                        target: sideBar.onTopPanel ? favoriteSystemActions : favoriteApps
+                        id: topItemProxyApps
+                        Layout.fillHeight: false
+                        Layout.bottomMargin: 0
+                        target: favoriteApps
+                        visible: !sideBar.systemOnTop
+                    }
+                    LayoutItemProxy {
+                        id: topItemProxySystem
+                        Layout.fillHeight: false
+                        Layout.bottomMargin: 0
+                        target: favoriteSystemActions
+                        visible: sideBar.systemOnTop
+                    }
+
+                    RepositionDropArea {
+                        implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.medium + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing * 2
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        Layout.leftMargin: -sideBar.margins.left + sideBar.innerMargin
+                        Layout.rightMargin: -sideBar.margins.right + sideBar.innerMargin
+                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+                        visible: (sidebarSeparator.Drag.active && sidebarSpacer.Layout.fillHeight)
+                        onDropped: {
+                            Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarBottomAlignment = 1
+                            Plasmoid.configuration.writeConfig()
+                        }
+                    }
+                    Item {
+                        id: sidebarSpacer
+                        Layout.fillHeight: (Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarBottomAlignment == 0 &&!sideBar.onTopPanel) || Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarBottomAlignment == 2
                     }
+
                     KSvg.SvgItem {
                         id: sidebarSeparator
 
                         Layout.fillWidth: true
                         Layout.leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                         Layout.rightMargin: Layout.leftMargin
-                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
 
                         visible: (favoriteApps.model && favoriteApps.model.count
                             && favoriteSystemActions.model && favoriteSystemActions.model.count)
 
                         imagePath: "widgets/line"
                         elementId: "horizontal-line"
+                        Drag.dragType: Drag.Automatic
+
+                        HoverHandler {
+                            margin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                            cursorShape: Qt.DragMoveCursor
+                        }
+                        DragHandler {
+                            id: sideBarDragHandler
+                            target: null
+                            margin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                            cursorShape: Qt.DragMoveCursor
+                            onActiveChanged: if (active) {
+                                const targetItem = sideBar.systemOnTop ? favoriteApps : favoriteSystemActions
+                                targetItem.grabToImage(function(result) {
+                                    sidebarSeparator.Drag.imageSource = result.url
+                                    sidebarSeparator.Drag.active = true // using a binding can cause loop warnings when unexpanding
+                                }, Qt.size(targetItem.implicitWidth, targetItem.implicitHeight))
+                            } else {
+                                sidebarSeparator.Drag.active = false // using a binding can cause loop warnings when unexpanding
+                            }
+                        }
+
                     }
+
                     LayoutItemProxy {
-                        target: sideBar.onTopPanel ? favoriteApps : favoriteSystemActions
+                        id: bottomItemProxyApps
+                        target: favoriteApps
+                        Layout.fillHeight: !sidebarSpacer.Layout.fillHeight
+                        visible: sideBar.systemOnTop
                     }
 
+                    LayoutItemProxy {
+                        id: bottomItemProxySystem
+                        target: favoriteSystemActions
+                        Layout.fillHeight: !sidebarSpacer.Layout.fillHeight
+                        visible: !sideBar.systemOnTop
+                    }
+
+
                     SideBarSection {
                         id: favoriteApps
 
-                        Layout.fillHeight: true
                         Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
 
                         KeyNavigation.up: favoriteSystemActions.bottomSideBarItem
@@ -257,6 +378,47 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
                     }
                 }
             }
+
+            RepositionDropArea {
+                id: bottomDropArea
+                visible: (sidebarSeparator.Drag.active && !sidebarSpacer.Layout.fillHeight) || bottomTransition.running
+                anchors {
+                    top: parent.bottom
+                    left: parent.left
+                    right: parent.right
+                    bottomMargin: sideBar.innerMargin
+                    leftMargin: sideBarScrollView.leftPadding + sideBar.innerMargin
+                    rightMargin: sideBarScrollView.rightPadding + sideBar.innerMargin
+                }
+                onDropped: {
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesSidebarBottomAlignment = 2
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.writeConfig()
+                }
+                states: [
+                    State {
+                        name: "hidden"
+                        when: !sidebarSeparator.Drag.active
+                        AnchorChanges  {
+                            target: bottomDropArea
+                            anchors.top: parent.bottom
+                            anchors.bottom: undefined
+                        }
+                    },
+                    State {
+                        name: "visible"
+                        when: sidebarSeparator.Drag.active
+                        AnchorChanges {
+                            target: bottomDropArea
+                            anchors.top: undefined
+                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+                        }
+                    }
+                ]
+                transitions: Transition {
+                    id: bottomTransition
+                    AnchorAnimation { duration: Kirigami.Units.shortDuration }
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         ItemListView {
diff --git a/applets/kicker/main.xml b/applets/kicker/main.xml
index 53f8f9d7b7..4606d4afb2 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/main.xml
+++ b/applets/kicker/main.xml
@@ -99,6 +99,22 @@
       <label>The amount of columns in the Favorites Dashboard grid.</label>
       <default>3</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="favoritesSidebarTopCategory" type="Enum">
+      <label>The category of favorites that appears at the top of Kicker sidebar. Option "Default" responds to the widget's location.</label>
+      <choices>
+        <choice name="Adaptive"/>
+        <choice name="Applications"/>
+        <choice name="SystemActions"/>
+      </choices>
+      <default>0</default>
+    </entry>
+    <entry name="favoritesSidebarBottomAlignment" type="Enum">
+      <label>Whether the bottom category in Kicker's favorites sidebar, in case the sidebar is longer than needed, is aligned directly after the first category (empty space at the end) or at the end of the sidebar (empty space in the middle). Option "Adaptive" responds to the widget's location. </label>
+      <choice name="Adaptive"/>
+      <choice name="After" />
+      <choice name="End" />
+      <default>0</default>
+    </entry>
 
   </group>
 </kcfg>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, bottom panel: favorites are at the top of the sidebar, far from the panel
With the MR, after dragging the separator to the top: system actions on top, favorites at the bottom next to the panel
Dragging the separator: drop zones appear, dropping on the top one swaps the sections
